selector.champion: IgG4-related rhinosinusitis with concurrent Streptococcus constellatus bacterial rhinosinusitis
selector.rationale: The presence of dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells, with most being IgG4 positive, along with positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus and opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Tolosa-Hunt syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for this condition

rejected.label: Streptococcal sinusitis
rejected.why: While Streptococcus constellatus is present, the IgG4-related findings are more prominent

rejected.label: Invasive fungal sinusitis
rejected.why: Contradicted by the presence of Streptococcus constellatus and lack of fungal evidence
